facts.fact: RNE Director General Adel Chouari said some National Business Register services are fully digitised, others experimental or in final phase, and incorporation is being digitised starting with individuals, with 90% of services online targeted by mid-2025.

TUN.note: Only a remark that digitising contracts is hampered by electronic signature measures; no law stated.
No national ID number use by a register stated.
Nothing on electronic tax or fee payment.
Nothing on tax filing or payment systems.
A tax identification number is mentioned as a step before incorporation; no register or sharing stated.
